DataContext.description:
Which Loamz Data workspace this conversation is about, and which of its catalogs the person chose to look at.

The application states it for one conversation (it is not the person's identity, which only the verified sign-in gives). Loamz
Data still decides what the person may read: naming a workspace they are not in gets nothing, and a choice of catalogs can
only take away from what they may read.
DataContext.title: DataContext

McpContextUpdate.description:
POST /threads/{id}/mcp-context: the state an interactive MCP app sends so the model sees it next turn.

`context` is app-specific (board state, playback, a selected colour); it is serialised as JSON for the model.
McpContextUpdate.title: McpContextUpdate

A change to a note. Nothing is overwritten or deleted: new text is a new note that replaces the old one, and a status change is
